items: ✨ 【2K Ultra HD Video & Color Night Vision with Spotlight】 Capture clear 2K video with enhanced detail throughout the day. At night, the built-in spotlight illuminates the scene to deliver color night vision, improving visibility and awareness in dark environments.

☁️ 【Free Cloud & Local Storage Choices】 Get 3-day encrypted cloud storage at no cost, with quick playback through the app and no subscription fees. You can also use a TF card (up to 256GB, not included) for local storage, ideal for longer recordings. Cloud videos are saved in 720p to help speed up uploads and make remote viewing smoother.

🔋 【Extended Battery Life & Optional Solar Charging】 With an efficient battery and intelligent power-saving design, the camera offers multiple working modes to help extend usage time—typically lasting 1 to 5 months on a full charge. For continuous operation, you can pair it with a compatible solar panel (sold separately), enabling truly wireless use without frequent recharging.

🚨 【Smart Motion Alerts & Built-In Siren】 AI-enhanced PIR motion detection quickly identifies activity and sends real-time notifications to your phone. The integrated siren can be activated to help discourage unwanted visitors, and you can easily share camera access with family members or trusted users.

🌧️ 【IP66 Weatherproof & Dust Resistant】 Designed with an IP66-rated housing, the camera is built to handle rain, wind, and dusty environments, delivering stable performance outdoors in a wide range of weather conditions.

🤝 【Hassle-Free Setup & Always-On Support】 Set up the camera effortlessly through the app with only a few simple steps. Our dedicated customer service team is available 24/7 to answer questions and provide assistance whenever you need it.
